nature: LLM-generated Q&A about security concepts (not real incident reports); no ground-truth labels.

class_definitions.xss: Cross-site scripting and client-side script injection / CSP / DOM issues.
class_definitions.injection: Server-side injection: SQLi, command/LDAP/template injection, XXE, SSRF.
class_definitions.csrf_session: CSRF, session hijacking/fixation, cookie and session handling.
class_definitions.malware: Malware families and behaviour: trojans, botnets, rootkits, RATs, ransomware, C2.
class_definitions.vulnerability: Memory-safety bugs, exploitation techniques, CVEs, privilege escalation, patching.
class_definitions.network_attack: DDoS, MITM, scanning, DNS/ARP attacks, firewall/IDS topics.
class_definitions.incident_response: IR, forensics, SIEM/SOC, threat hunting, MITRE-based detection.
class_definitions.other: None of the above is the main topic.
